details: When using urllib3's proxy support with ProxyManager, the Proxy-Authorization header is only sent to the configured proxy. However, when not using proxy support, the header may be accidentally configured and is not stripped during cross-origin redirects.
summary: urllib3's Proxy-Authorization request header isn't stripped during cross-origin redirects
